summary: Adds a cloud-neutral production Helm chart with split API/worker roles and dedicated database migration authority.
userImpact: Kubernetes and OpenShift operators can run redundant frontend, API, and background-worker replicas from immutable images.
Existing Compose and self-hosted deployments keep the combined runtime and automatic migration behavior by default.
The optional Plugin Manager remains internal and plugin assets are shared read-only across host replicas.

instructions: Create separate application, migration, and preflight database credentials before enabling verify-only startup.
Render and validate the chart, then use an atomic Helm upgrade so migration and preflight hooks complete before rollout.

configuration: Adds EG_RUNTIME_ROLE=all|api|worker; the default all preserves the previous process model.
Adds EG_DATABASE_STARTUP_MODE=apply|verify; the default apply preserves automatic self-hosted migration behavior.
Adds enterpriseglue-host chart values for immutable images, external configuration/secrets, replicas, autoscaling, ingress, NetworkPolicy, plugin assets, and Plugin Manager.

changes: No HTTP API is removed or renamed; split API replicas serve the same routes.
Worker-only processes intentionally do not open an HTTP listener.

notes: No schema migration is introduced by this slice.
Verify-only startup detects missing or pending schema work without DDL; migration hooks retain apply authority.

security: Application and worker identities can be deprived of schema DDL while dedicated hooks apply and verify migrations.
Only the frontend is an ingress target; API and Plugin Manager traffic remains cluster-internal under NetworkPolicy.
Pods run non-root with dropped capabilities, read-only root filesystems, bounded resources, immutable images, PDBs, and topology spread.
documentation: Adds chart values, installation guidance, migration authority, scale/failure behavior, rollback, and qualification runbooks.
knownLimitations: Cloud provider resources and real-cluster qualification remain owned by the deployment repository and combined qualification lanes.
rollback: Use Helm rollback only while the database schema remains compatible with the target application image.
Do not automatically run down migrations or delete Plugin Manager journals, tenant state, eligibility, SSO references, or plugin-owned data.
validation: Helm lint/render contracts cover Kubernetes, OpenShift, split and combined profiles, immutable images, database hooks, security contexts, ingress isolation, shared assets, and optional Plugin Manager.
Database tests cover verify-only startup and fail-closed pending migrations.
